en: Francis, congratulations.
There's been lightning in the area,
there was electricity on the court tonight.
Talk us through the last few games
and how you managed those emotions.
I thought I played a great first match point.
Missed the backhand,
just overcooked the backhand,
had a pick up and you know got broken.
I did play a great game and break back.
So did I there at the end.
I mean look, he's a hell of a player.
We've been at the top for a while.
He's gonna make you beat him
and that's what I did tonight.
What did you
have to figure out strategically
over the course of the match?
I just got to play the win.
You know we're all long seasons.
We're all just at one percent,
just trying to figure it out.
Guy who just plays a little more brave
at certain moments gets it
and I was hitting my shots great tonight.
From back in the court I've
been playing really well
so I was just counting on that.
You've been to the final here before.
How much does that help you for what's
to come?
Every match is its own story,
its own journey.
I'm just happy to be another semi,
get a chance to be in the final, hopefully.
So I'm just gonna go out there and compete
as hard as I can and give myself a chance.
That's all I'm gonna do.
Bravo.
